_comment: PortfoliFLOW UI Theme — Corporate Blue variant. Same dark base as the default with a blue accent instead of red — less aggressive, more institutional. Loaded by gui/theme.py via core/ui_theme.py.

semantic._comment_table_bg_dark: Dark-theme variants used by ADR-0062 heatmap tinting on performance columns (Excess, Alpha, IR, ...). Desaturated dark green / dark red read as a perceptible tint on the canonical #0A0A0A background without overpowering cell text.

pf._comment: Web-shell tokens emitted under --pf-* by scripts/generate_theme_artifacts.py. The stepper palette was retired with the single-button Data Import refactor (sub-stream 6F).
